第74章 处长，我要学外语-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

“处长好。”

“黎志义的事，跟你通报一下。”

顾承安一手握着方向盘，一手拿着手机。

“您说，我听着！”

“他和相关人员今天一早已经押回鹏城了，这回免不了去布吉走一遭了，这下你放心了吧…”

布吉，鹏城一个传说中的地方。

顾承安嗯了一声，没多问，知道这个就够了，不枉他一番周折。

处长继续说：“还有你之前提的马克·西蒙那几个暗子，昨晚全部抓获了。马克西蒙本人醒了之后不到一个小时就开始撂了，当然——”

处长顿了顿，“我们也清楚他没全撂，这老狐狸想待价而沽，留着筹码慢慢谈，不过嘛～没关系，我相信他很快就会想通的！”

顾承安能想象到处长说这话时的表情，大概是那种笑眯眯的、让人后背发凉的笑。

“另外有件事。”处长的语气微微一转，“你最近这个督察专员的身份，在鹏城动静有点大了。”

顾承安闻言眉头动了动。

“根据线报，已经引起了一部分当地人员的注意，原本给你这个身份，是考虑偶尔需要的时候能镇住场子。没想到你小子除了本职工作干得漂亮，打击其他犯罪也搞得风生水起，跟当地警方接触太频繁了。”

处长叹了口气：“鉴于这些情况，建议你休息一段时间，放放假，冷一冷。”

顾承安沉默了下。

放假？

他上一次放假是什么时候来着……好像是几天前吧！

“处长，我闲不住。”顾承安直说，“要不这样，给我找个地方学点东西？地上跑的、天上飞的，还有外语啥的这类特殊技能，我想系统学一下，艺多不压身嘛！”

电话那头安静了下来，隔了好几秒才回道：

“你小子脑子转得倒快。”处长笑了一声，“行，这确实是个好办法，既能冷却身份，又不浪费时间，你等我消息。”

通话结束。

顾承安把保密手机收回兜里，车子拐进小区地库，回到家，躺在沙发上盯着天花板发呆。

脑子里转的全是处长最后那句“等消息”。

以他对处长的了解，这人办事从来不过夜。

果然。

"Hello, Director."

"I'll let you know about Li Zhiyi."

Gu Chengan held the steering wheel in one hand and his mobile phone in the other.

"You say it and I listen!"

"He and the relevant personnel have been escorted back to Pengcheng early this morning. They will inevitably go to Buji this time. Don't worry now..."

Buji, a legendary place in Pengcheng.

Gu Chengan hummed and didn't ask any more questions. It was enough to know that it was not worth his troubles.

The director continued: "As well as the secret agents of Maxim Simon you mentioned before, they were all captured last night. Maxim himself started to give up within an hour after he woke up. Of course -"

The director paused, "We also know that he didn't give up everything. This old fox wants to wait for the price and keep the chips to negotiate slowly, but it doesn't matter. I believe he will figure it out soon!"

Gu Chengan could imagine the expression on the director's face when he said this, probably a smile that would send chills down the back.

"There's another thing." The director's tone changed slightly, "As an inspector, you have made a lot of noise in Pengcheng recently."

Gu Chengan's brows moved when he heard this.

"According to the tip, it has attracted the attention of some local personnel. I originally gave you this identity to calm down the situation when needed occasionally. I didn't expect that in addition to your job, your kid is also very successful in fighting other crimes, and you have too frequent contacts with the local police."

The director sighed: "In view of these circumstances, I suggest you take some time off, take a vacation, and chill out."

Gu Chengan was silent for a moment.

Have a holiday?

When was the last time he had a vacation... It seemed like a few days ago!

"Director, I can't sit still." Gu Cheng'an said bluntly, "How about you find a place for me to learn something? Running on the ground, flying in the sky, and special skills such as foreign languages. I want to learn them systematically. I don't have to worry about so many skills!"

The other end of the phone fell silent, and it took a few seconds before he replied:

"You're a quick thinker." The director laughed, "Okay, this is indeed a good way. It can cool down your identity without wasting time. Just wait for my news."

The call ends.

Gu Chengan put his confidential mobile phone back in his pocket, turned the car into the basement of the community, returned home, and lay on the sofa staring at the ceiling in a daze.

All that was running through my mind was the Director's last words, "Waiting for news."

Based on his understanding of the director, this person never works overnight.
